sources.title: ConceptNet releases open-source 4-layer voice intent classifier with 98 ...
sources.snippet: ConceptNet has published an open-source, fine-tuned distilbert-base-multilingual-cased model designed for enterprise voice intent classification. The system utilizes a four-layer hierarchy to categorize commands into basic, context-aware, predictive, and autonomous intents.
